title: Customers counts include odd spellings and every status, never Counter Sale
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A (made for this test) is held by no customer.
  • Before you start, write down how many customers hold Net 30 (number B; the Counter Sale customer is never counted).
  • Have a contacts import file with three new customers: customer B with the credit term text "NET 30", one with "net30" and one with term A written in capital letters.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through Settings, Data Import, Contacts.
  2. Reload the Credit Terms page.
  3. Set customer B's status to inactive on its customer page.
  4. Reload the Credit Terms page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The three customers are created (none is refused).

Step 2:

  • Net 30 reads number B + 2 (for example 40 + 2 = 42): "NET 30" and "net30" both count as Net 30.
  • Term A reads 1.

Step 3:

  • The customer is inactive.

Step 4:

  • Net 30 still reads number B + 2: customers count whatever their status.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S1-R12: “The Customers column shows how many customers hold the term, right aligned, showing 0 when none. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer with a blank term is counted under COD. Names that differ only in capitals and spaces count toward the same term ("NET 30" counts as Net 30; see §6).”
  • Terminology: “In use → A term is in use when at least one customer, vendor or invoice (work order or part sale invoice) holds it. Vendor invoices, deliveries and vendor credits store no term, so they never count. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer or vendor with a blank term counts as COD. Every invoice ever created counts, including reversed and paid ones; estimates never count. Customers and vendors count and are listed whatever their status.”
  • Assumptions: “Stored customer and vendor terms carry inconsistent spellings from old imports and migrations (for example "NET 30" and "Due On Receipt"); every count, match and move treats names as equal when they differ only in capitals and spaces.”
  • S11-E2: “Customers whose stored term has an odd spelling (for example "NET 30") keep that stored text; they count under the matching term on the page and show their stored text on the card.”
  • S10-R3: “A credit term that matches one of the shop's terms (standard or its own) ignoring capitals and spaces is saved in that term's spelling: "net 10", "NET10" and "Net 10" all save as the shop's "Net 10". This applies to customers and vendors created or updated by an import, and created or updated through the Public API.”
